title: Dinaledi Tse di Lesome le Bongwe Tse di Obegileng
intro: Setshwantsho se se tswang mo Quran se ne sa newa pono e e tseneletseng mo bongwaneng — toro ya dilo tsa selegodimo tse di obamang ka tlotlo. Go ne go tla feta dingwaga di le dintsi ba oka, ba kgaogana, ba latofadiwa ka maaka le go tsenngwa mo kgolegelong pele ponatshegelo eno e diragala. Ke mang moya ono o o nonofileng o kgang ya one e tsayang kgaolo e telele go gaisa tsotlhe mo Quran?
clues: Ke kile ka bo ke le monnye, ke segofaditswe ka toro e e gakgamatsang e le rre ka boene a neng a ntlhagisa gore ke e boloke e le sephiri.
Bomorwarre ka namana, ba ba neng ba foufaditswe ke lefufa, ba ne ba ntlhoma leano mme ba ntatlhela mo sedibeng se se boteng, se se lefifi.
Ke ne ka isiwa kwa lefatsheng le le kgakala mme ka rekisiwa mo ntlong ya modiredimogolo mongwe yo o tlotlegang, koo ke neng ka bona kamogelo gone mme ka nna le maikarabelo.
Go latofadiwa ka maaka go ne ga dira gore ke tsenngwe mo kgolegelong go sa tshwanela, le fa go ntse jalo mo lefelong leo le le lefifi ke ne ka gomodiwa ke go rapela le go obamela Allah.
Allah o ne a ntshegofatsa ka bokgoni jo bo sa tlwaelegang jwa go ranola ditoro, jo kgabagare bo neng jwa nkisa fa pele ga mmusi wa naga mme jwa ntsholetsa kwa maemong a a kwa godimo a go tshepiwa.

Morago ga dingwaga tse ditelele re kgaogane, ke ne ka kopana gape le lelapa la gaetsho le le rategang, mme toro ya me ya bongwana ya dinaledi di le lesome le bongwe, letsatsi le ngwedi di nkobamela kgabagare e ne ya diragadiwa.

trial.answer: Go latlhelwa mo sedibeng se se boteng, se se lefifi ke bakaulengwe ba ba fufegelang

location.answer: Sediba se se omileng kwa sekakeng se ke neng ke latlhilwe mo go sone

outcome.label: Botso
options: Go kopanngwa gape le ba lelapa morago ga dingwaga di le dintsi ba kgaogane mme a nna moruti yo o ikanyegang
O eteletse pele khudugo e kgolo ya batho ba me go kgabaganya lewatle le le kgaoganeng
O tlhagisitse setšhaba sa me ka tshenyego e e tlang e e neng ya ba ja
A aga ntlo e e boitshepo e e neng ya nna lefelo le le boitshepo la botlhe
E dule ka pabalesego mo mpeng ya sebopiwa se segolo morago ga malatsi a le mararo
outcome.answer: Go kopanngwa gape le ba lelapa morago ga dingwaga di le dintsi ba kgaogane mme a nna moruti yo o ikanyegang

arabic: وَقَالَ ٱلَّذِى ٱشْتَرَىٰهُ مِن مِّصْرَ لِٱمْرَأَتِهِۦٓ أَكْرِمِى مَثْوَىٰهُ عَسَىٰٓ أَن يَنفَعَنَآ أَوْ نَتَّخِذَهُۥ وَلَدًۭا ۚ وَكَذَٰلِكَ مَكَّنَّا لِيُوسُفَ فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ وَلِنُعَلِّمَهُۥ مِن تَأْوِيلِ ٱلْأَحَادِيثِ ۚ وَٱللَّهُ غَالِبٌ عَلَىٰٓ أَمْرِهِۦ وَلَـٰكِنَّ أَكْثَرَ ٱلنَّاسِ لَا يَعْلَمُونَ
verse: And the one from Egypt who bought him said to his wife, "Make his residence comfortable. Perhaps he will benefit us, or we will adopt him as a son." And thus, We established Joseph in the land that We might teach him the interpretation of events [i.e., dreams]. And Allāh is predominant over His affair, but most of the people do not know. (12:21)
